name: Nazara Technologies

snapshot.about: Global gaming operating platform across mobile, PC, console, offline gaming, adtech, and sports media businesses.

narrative: Management delivered strong growth in gaming, with segment revenue rising 107% in FY26 against a 20-25% target. However, profitability diverged in Q2 FY27 as EBITDA margin hit 11.0% and PC publishing margins dropped to 27% in Q1 FY27.

promises.statement: Curve Games' target margin is always 50% on any signed game.

said.quote: Yes, our margin target is always 50% on any game that we sign

actual_source.quote: PC and console publishing businesses continue to deliver strong profitability, with FY '26 revenue of INR 261 crores and EBITDA of INR 101 crores at 39% EBITDA margin

promises.note: PC and console publishing margins fell to 39% in FY26 and 27% in Q1 FY27.

promises.statement: Company targets core gaming revenue growth of 20-25% year-on-year.

said.quote: We are targeting to grow our core gaming business at 20-25% year-on-year

actual_source.quote: FY '26 revenue growing 107% year-on-year to INR 1,072 crores and EBITDA growing 157% to INR 265 crores

promises.statement: Company aims for 20-25% EBITDA margin range in core gaming business.

actual_source.quote: resulting in an EBITDA margin of 24.7%

promises.statement: Offline gaming EBITDA margin expected to land between 25% to 35% on a steady state.

said.quote: I think on a steady state, what I said earlier, between 25% to 35% is where we should land up at

said.quote: Eventually, the margin should rise to beyond 20% is what we are working towards
